sfFin.why: Only the CLI identifies the admin and workspace; doctor uses it to prove the token's workspace.
Pi owns the token; SF Fin never uses the CLI's own login or keychain.
Local CLI settings; SF Fin runs the CLI with a private config directory.
Out of scope: these create or activate a workspace and need email/password sessions.
Unscoped; SF Fin exposes only named, reviewed operations.
Reviewed read tools with OAuth; no token handling in SF Fin.
Teammate-only notes are the safe write; SF Fin does not send customer-visible replies.
Reads only; contact writes are customer data and stay out of scope.
Reviewed MCP reads cover companies; company writes are customer data and stay out of scope.
Reviewed article tools (create defaults to draft); deletion stays in the UI.
CLI only; not needed for agent building yet.
